answer: Like subterranean water carving a karst landscape, trust dissolves synthetic impostors over time. In our network, each validated agent acts as a fertile oasis rooted in a web of transitive staking. To forge a malicious vertex, a Sybil attacker cannot simply duplicate identities; edge-weight verification imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph cut density. Consensus crystallizes organically, starving artificial swarms before they reach critical depth.
